settings.subTagline: Your Vision, Our Creativity, Perfectly Crafted.
settings.aboutDescription: SAIGRAPHICS is a post production studio in Bhagalpur, Bihar, focused on professional photo editing, video post production, creative graphics and visual finishing.
settings.address: Sai Graphics, 1st Floor, Sah Market, Picture Place, Bhagalpur, Bihar, India.
settings.shortAddress: 1st Floor, Sah Market, Picture Place, Bhagalpur, Bihar.
settings.openingHours: Mon - Sat: 9:30 AM - 8:30 PM | Sunday: By Appointment

services.title: Professional Photo Editing
services.shortDesc: High-end studio retouching, dynamic range recovery, composition refinement, and precision exposure correction.
services.fullDesc: From commercial catalogs to personal portraits, our studio utilizes advanced skin tone separation, micro-contrast enhancement, and background cleanup to achieve pristine publication-grade standards.

services.title: Wedding Photo Editing
services.shortDesc: Bespoke ceremony and reception photo finishing honoring traditional emotions and royal Indian color palettes.
services.fullDesc: Specialized in Indian wedding rituals (Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, Jaimala, and Bidaai). We balance rich maroons, gold tones, and warm skin complexions while retaining crisp details in heavy embroidery.

services.title: Cinematic Video Editing
services.shortDesc: Rhythmic narrative pacing, seamless scene transitions, multi-cam synchronization, and emotive score alignment.
services.fullDesc: Crafting captivating wedding teasers, highlights, and full-length cinematic films. We craft dramatic storytelling arcs using slow-motion ramps, sound design, and master-level scene pacing.

services.title: Video Post Production
services.shortDesc: End-to-end mastering including audio mastering, dialogue cleanup, noise suppression, and subtitle formatting.
services.fullDesc: Comprehensive studio visual finishing for commercial ads, YouTube creators, corporate films, and documentaries. Multi-track audio sweetening, high-fidelity render outputs up to 8K HDR.

services.title: Creative Graphic Design
services.shortDesc: Distinctive brand identities, promotional banners, custom wedding invitations, posters, and digital creatives.
services.fullDesc: High-impact visual collateral blending modern typography with rich Indian royal embellishments. Vector artwork, social media marketing kits, event backdrops, and printed collateral.

services.title: Video Graphy & Candid Photography
services.shortDesc: Cinematic 4K on-location recording, authentic DJI drone 360° aerial views, and candid moment capture by seasoned cinematographers.
services.fullDesc: On-field crew available across Bhagalpur and Bihar for weddings, pre-weddings, corporate celebrations, and cultural festivals with high-speed lenses, gimbals, and wireless audio setups.

services.title: Wedding Album Designing
services.shortDesc: Luxury lay-flat photobook layouts with metallic embossing, panoramic spreads, and archival photo preservation.
services.fullDesc: Artfully designed page-by-page album spreads that narrate your love story in chronological poetry. Printed on premium velvet matte, non-tear, and metallic-lustre photographic papers.

services.title: Photo Retouching
services.shortDesc: Frequency separation skin refinement, stray hair removal, eye brightening, and body contour perfection.
services.fullDesc: Editorial-grade magazine retouching preserving authentic skin texture without artificial plastic looks. Ideal for bridal portraits, beauty shoots, modeling folios, and executive headshots.

services.title: Color Grading
services.shortDesc: DaVinci Resolve color science, custom cinematic LUT development, tone matching, and HDR mastering.
services.fullDesc: Transform flat log footage into deep cinematic magic with film emulation, customized warm gold highlights, rich teal-shadow balance, and broadcast legal gamuts (Rec.709 & DCI-P3).

services.title: Visual Effects (VFX)
services.shortDesc: Dynamic title animations, screen replacements, sky replacements, slow-motion stabilization, and 3D particles.
services.fullDesc: Elevate promotional clips and wedding teasers with sparkling light particle effects, dreamy smoke aesthetics, smooth speed ramps, object tracking, and seamless rotoscoping.
